summary: Regression: When clocked in on mobile view, line is no longer green. Techs cannot tell easily which line they are clocked into.
reported_issue: On the mobile view, when a user is clocked in, the line is not green anymore. The only indicator is the STOP button; the green line indicator is gone. Mobile view only.
expected_after_fix: When clocked into a line on mobile, the line should show a green indicator so technicians can easily tell which line they are clocked into.
steps_i_followed: Emulated an iPhone (390x844, isMobile+touch) and opened the mobile Work Orders view.
Tapped 'Clock In', selected a work order (S9-24927) with an Approved line.
Captured the line card background color BEFORE clocking in (white, rgb(255,255,255)).
Tapped 'Start' on the approved line to clock into it.
Captured the line card background color and header state AFTER clocking in.
Cleaned up: stopped the line timer and clocked out (verified header returned to 'Clock In').
actual_now: When clocked into the line, the entire line card turns GREEN: background color changes from white to rgba(165,214,167,0.3) (a light green / Material green-200 tint). The header shows a green stop_circle icon with a running timer (00:00:01...), the WO status badge flips to 'In Progress', and the line shows a red 'Stop' button. The green line indicator is clearly present, making it easy to identify the clocked-into line.
notes: Tested via Chromium mobile-viewport emulation. Measured the line card computed background color before vs after clocking in: white -> green tint rgba(165,214,167,0.3). Cleaned up by stopping the line and clocking admin out (verified). No Tech role change was needed for this test.
